about.lead: I study Artificial Intelligence at Bahauddin Zakariya University and build full-stack software alongside my studies.
about.body: My work includes web applications, AI assistants, document tools, and automation. I handle the interface, application logic, data, and model integrations needed to make each product work.

sections.title: Areas I work in
paragraphs: I work with language model integrations, document workflows, and automation, as well as the web interfaces and backend systems around them. Recent projects include a university assistant, a collaborative document editor, and a property-listing monitor.

sections.title: How I work
paragraphs: I begin with the task a product needs to support, then build and refine the workflow around it. I aim for clear interfaces, reliable data handling, and AI features tied to a specific use.

Independent development and co-founding China Vibes have also given me experience with product decisions, daily operations, and customer experience. I plan to keep developing as an AI product engineer.
